mapping.summary: In-BC spreadsheets on live data for financial reports, dashboards and G/L budgets.
claims: Sheet areas bind to BC tables, financial reports, budgets, queries and reports
Opens any financial report as a spreadsheet with period and dimension slicers
Dashboards with KPI cards, charts, pivot tables and slicers
Budget entry in an accounts-by-months grid written straight to G/L budget entries
Shows last year's actuals next to budget cells, with lines per department or project
Editable lists with your own calculated columns
Drill from any number to underlying records with Ctrl+click
Formulas include SUM, AVERAGE, XLOOKUP and G/L functions
Exports to Excel with native tables and charts
Per-sheet sharing with owner, read-only or budget-edit rights
What-if scenarios, conditional formatting and multi-company regions
Optional AI assistant builds dashboards from a description using your own AI provider
Financial report rows can pull data from any table, including quotes, orders and journals
Cross-company reporting and consolidation with currency conversion
Scheduled report distribution to email or SharePoint in several formats
Financial reports exposed as API endpoints for Power BI
Sandboxes run without a licence key
